use_case_summary: Small SaaS building a knowledge + chat feature inside a Next.js app deployed on Vercel. Primary needs: searchable product docs (embeddings + rerank), short transactional chat flows (support-agent), and on-page summarization. Wants easy LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters and Vercel serverless examples for quick POC.
notes: Inbound lead via docs quickstart. Signed up self-serve, using trial credits. Tech stack: Next.js (Vercel), TypeScript, S3 for docs, Postgres for metadata. Primary ask: 'Do you have a LangChain + Vercel quickstart that shows streaming responses on Edge and an embeddings pipeline that writes to Vector DB?' Also asked about LlamaIndex compatibility and a minimal adapter for Redwood hosted API. AE landed a short call — SE Diego joined. Quote from Head of Eng: 'We need something we can ship in a week to validate UX — low-friction SDK + example repo is critical.' They are cost-sensitive; estimate 500-2k DAU for Q3 POC. Latency target: <300ms median for short-turn chat, 100-200ms for embedding lookups (cold), throughput target ~20 qps on embeddings endpoint during peak. Interested in automatic fallbacks to cheaper model when load spikes and in batched embedding ingestion to reduce cost. Security: want SSO (SAML) and basic audit logs; SOC2 evidence required for procurement. POC plan: 2-week technical spike (LangChain integration + Vercel demo), then security review. Pinned asks for deliverables: 1) LangChain LLMChain example using Redwood API key flow, 2) LlamaIndex loader example for S3 + simple adapter, 3) Vercel Edge function showing streaming tokens to the browser, 4) short README with token cost examples. AE notes: share quickstart repo (drive:/playbooks/langchain-vercel-quickstart.md) and a trimmed pricing sheet. Ticket INF-1429 opened to track quickstart delivery.
